what: A stack of icon cards overlapped in the same spot. Only the front three show, each raised 2px and tilted 5°, −3° and 0°. Hovering the stack lifts the second card 20px (framer default spring 500·25). On press, with the second card still lifted, the front card vanishes in .125s and goes to the back. The rest move forward one slot each (position .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.35,1), tilt by spring) and the new front card settles down. Hovering the front card drops the name pill below it in from 10px above over .3s

options.lift: Height (px) the second sheet lifts on hover or press, default 20
options.step: Height each later sheet rises (px), default 2
options.tilt: Tilt from the front (degrees, comma-separated), default 5,-3,0 — 0,0,0 keeps it straight
options.fade: Seconds for the first slide to fade out, default .125 — 0 means instantly
options.--fx-size · --fx-radius: Card size and corner radius (style), default 72px · 16px
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Overlapping cards (children, two or more) — data-name is the label text

use: ……

from.where: index.html .rb-deck — original framer-motion useAnimate: second card y −20 → front card opacity 0 (.125) → array rotated → y 0, slot top −2i · rotate 5/−3/0 · opacity i>2?0:1, whileHover second y −20, label peer-hover −10px→0 .3s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)

note: On phone (hover false) no hover lift is applied, only press-to-flip. When done, fx:shuffle(detail.top).
